fence.intent: Webhook deliveries that hit a 503 are retried with backoff instead of being dropped.
fence.head: 9f2c41e

findings.claim: Retries also fire on 400, so a bad payload is sent five times.
findings.evidence: [ran] new test test_no_retry_on_4xx failed before the change and passes on 9f2c41e
findings.reply: Only 429 and 5xx retry now; 4xx goes straight to the dead-letter table.

findings.claim: Backoff has no jitter, so many failed hooks retry at the same instant.
findings.evidence: [read] deliver.py@9f2c41e line 63 now adds random 0-30% jitter; test_backoff_bounds checks the range
[traced] deliver() is only called from the single worker loop in worker.py@9f2c41e; no threads share the session
findings.reply: The session is owned by one worker process and never shared across threads (see worker.py run_loop).

findings.claim: The billing client has the same drop-on-503 problem.
findings.reply: Agreed it is the same bug; the billing client is outside this PR, so I opened it as a follow-up.
